title: Power Smart pipeline hides push before duplicate check
description: `npm run pipeline` hardcodes the golden intake and immediately calls `push-both`, while the workflow skills describe duplicate lookup and explicit pushes afterward. A visual run can therefore hide a side effect inside extraction and create duplicate records before the documented duplicate check. Add file input and `--prepare-only`, use it before lookup, and retain explicit visible pushes.
evidence: scripts/acumatica/pipeline.ts parsed SAMPLE_ORDER_TEXT and invoked push-both in phase 4
.agents/skills/power-smart-order-intake/SKILL.md instructed the agent to run pipeline before duplicate lookup
